banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Reuse a pagination cursor after migration; identify unintended missing/duplicate results.
declaredContract: The opaque teaching cursor preserves the pinned six-profile snapshot, ascending ordinal/id order, original query and profile-v1 label schema across fictional v1/v2. Missing results can be certified only at an explicit terminal observation. Status 200, cursor acceptance and an absent next token do not prove correctness or completion.
preconditions: Open the local bundle in a standards-based browser; no server, package installation or Azure account.
All datasets, cursors, orders, schemas, tokens, state, versions, requests and results are fixed synthetic DATA ONLY.
One attempt permits one short nonterminal v1 page, one selected v2 receipt, and four ordered actions.
actions: Open v1 first page and retain its exact cursor and snapshot.
Select one fixed migration condition and change the fictional target to v2.
Reuse the exact saved teaching cursor; typed and state guards reject altered input.
Check observed IDs, duplicates, missing/unobserved IDs, ordering, schema and snapshot; inspect retained receipts/history.
Reset all explicitly clears the in-memory attempt and history.
assertions: Preserved: six unique ordered profile-v1 results across observed v1 and v2; positive local rehearsal only.
Accepted-missing/duplicate/reorder/schema/snapshot: interrupted despite fictional 200 and accepted cursor.
Unknown-completion: missingIds remains null; two unobserved IDs are not certified lost; no success.
Rejected-cursor: interruption and unknown completeness; v1 results remain retained.
Malformed typed inputs, corrupt state and illegal transitions do not mutate observations or history.
Actual DOM, keyboard, error, reset, unavailable-script and active CSP checks use the published isolated helper.
